reference_sql:
SELECT device.category AS device_category,
  SUM(list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'engagement_time_msec')[1].value.int_value) AS engagement_msec
FROM events
WHERE event_name = 'page_view'
  AND event_date = '20251120'
GROUP BY device.category
alternatives:
SELECT e.device.category AS device_category, SUM(p.value.int_value) AS engagement_msec
FROM events AS e, unnest(e.event_params) AS t(p)
WHERE e.event_name = 'page_view'
  AND e.event_date = '20251120'
  AND p.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
GROUP BY e.device.category

WITH views AS (
  -- one row per page_view on 20 November 2025
  SELECT device.category AS device_category,
    [p.value.int_value FOR p IN event_params IF p.key = 'engagement_time_msec'][1] AS engagement_msec
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'page_view'
    AND event_date = '20251120'
)
SELECT device_category, SUM(engagement_msec) AS engagement_msec
FROM views
GROUP BY device_category
